name: Replica Asset Image Generation
description: Extract used target entities from the localized storyboard, invoke the selected image model's Professional Prompt Skill against storyboard evidence, then render real managed reference images for characters, scenes and props.
when_to_use: CURRENT TARGET_STORYBOARD v2 exists and downstream video generation needs visual references
when_not_to_use: Localized storyboard is missing or stale

steps.title: 提取目标资产
steps.description: Collect only target characters/scenes/props actually referenced by the localized storyboard.

steps.title: 生成图片模型专属提示词
steps.description: Route each extracted asset and its localized storyboard evidence through the selected image model's Professional Prompt Skill; generic direct string concatenation is forbidden.

steps.title: 生成真实资产图
steps.description: Render managed image files, persist SHA/dimensions and bind them to stable target assets.

provider_rules: No text-only asset may satisfy the image contract
Every referenced target entity must receive at least one real reference image

Every image execution prompt must be authored by the selected image model Professional Prompt Skill from the extracted asset plus its localized storyboard evidence; do not concatenate raw biography/story prose directly into the Runtime prompt

Character assets must be deterministically composed by Runtime from separate front/side/back full-body renders plus a face close-up cropped from the front render; do not rely on one free-form multi-panel model generation
Narrative relationships must not create extra people in a single-character asset
Reference media must be persisted by Studio with SHA256 and dimensions
completion_criteria: Every referenced target entity has a model-specific Skill-authored image prompt
Character output structurally contains deterministic front/side/back full-body panels plus a front-derived facial close-up
Every referenced target entity has real reference media
All media is managed and technically readable
failure_policy: Any required entity without a generated image blocks publication
Runtime failure does not replace an existing CURRENT asset revision
